QuestInfo.name: [Shaolin Temple] But Everyone Else Has Nice Shoes
QuestInfo.0: The #b#p9310577##k that you met at the #r#m701220350##k has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: The #b#p9310577##k is really obsessed with the cute shoes that human kids wear. At first, the demon thought he could borrow a pair while a kid was asleep, then return the shoes in the morning, but he lost them! Find the lost shoes and return them to their owner.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved the shoes that #b#p9310577##k lost and returned them to their original owner. Return to the #b#p9310577##k.
